risks.risk: Full remote build/test parity remains intentionally paused during remediation and should be restored with newly aligned workflows after acceptance.
The package-listed windows-msvc-debug preset does not exist in this checkout; repository validation uses the debug preset.
vcpkg.json still has no builtin-baseline, so dependency resolution is not locked by the manifest alone.
ForsettiHostTemplate remains planned and not implemented as a CMake target.
Theme masks remain reserved and stripped even when declared; exposing module-owned theme policy needs a future owner decision.
UI field-shape validation beyond capability checks, such as duplicate toolbar IDs or unknown host slots, remains future hardening work.
Live WinHTTP success-path coverage is not included in deterministic unit tests; future integration coverage should use a controlled local HTTP server.
Capability-scoped service resolution gates known platform service interfaces; future governed services must be added to the capability mapping.
Module-originated general event publishing beyond module-to-module messages remains an API design question.
Registry-backed tests use unique roots; future cleanup tooling may remove old test roots under the repository test registry path.
